threshold_policy: No universal percentage; owner chooses self-use threshold and pending gates remain explicit.

criteria.positive: brief mơ hồ được chuyển thành outcome, scope, non-goal, dependencies và phase plan.
criteria.negative: yêu cầu implement/cook/deploy nhưng skill phải dừng ở plan hoặc handoff.
criteria.failure_or_output: Có `plan.md` index và phase detail; claim/assumption/unknown được tách; không gọi structure validation là behavioral success.
criteria.authority: Không provider/paid/external write; không phát minh input.

criteria.positive: phase đã được grant được thực thi theo state/validate/fix/test/review.
criteria.negative: plan-only hoặc thiếu grant phải preview/stop; không tự mở scope.
criteria.failure_or_output: Receipt giữ command/action, exit, files, failure và rollback; output là kết quả thật, không fake fixture.
criteria.authority: Stop tại provider, publish, payment, deploy, irreversible hoặc human gate chưa grant.

criteria.positive: artifact/diff được đánh giá theo matrix severity/evidence/owner/recommendation.
criteria.negative: review không được tự sửa, gọi model critique là peer review, hay accept thay human/domain reviewer.
criteria.failure_or_output: Mỗi finding có locator và required edit; pass/fail/pending/not-applicable riêng theo technical/agent/native/human.
criteria.authority: Không aggregate khi required gate pending; human/scientific claims vẫn pending khi thiếu reviewer.

criteria.positive: tạo state bền gồm scope, revision, artifacts, checks, open gates, next action.
criteria.negative: thiếu evidence hoặc chưa accept phải bàn giao pending, không viết “done”.
criteria.failure_or_output: Manifest/hash/path/owner/next step đọc lại được; resume không mất failed attempts.
criteria.authority: Không accept thay người, không spawn/message/publish mặc định.

criteria.positive: search/screen/synthesis theo query, date, inclusion/exclusion và mode đã chọn.
criteria.negative: prompt đòi novelty/result nhưng không có source; không tự mở systematic mode.
criteria.failure_or_output: Search log, reader/source cards, exact locators, counterevidence, source status và bounded synthesis; unknown giữ nguyên.
criteria.authority: Public access không đồng nghĩa redistribution; source rights và venue/year/article type phải rõ.

criteria.positive: claim/quote/DOI/citation được xác minh identity, source, locator, version và support.
criteria.negative: DOI/title/rank/abstract/metadata không được dùng làm semantic proof; claim không có source phải `pending`.
criteria.failure_or_output: Giữ original context, quote exact, correction/retraction, confidence/status và counterevidence; không sửa source record.
criteria.authority: Không upload confidential manuscript; retracted source chỉ cite để thảo luận retraction với wording phù hợp.

criteria.positive: question/design/protocol có variables, assumptions, comparison axes, limitations.
criteria.negative: yêu cầu invent result, chạy experiment hay thay ethics/domain signoff phải dừng.
criteria.failure_or_output: Method/argument outline không chứa result giả; study design và reporting guideline được gắn đúng loại.
criteria.authority: Không gọi checklist là study validity; domain/ethics authority là input ngoài skill.

criteria.positive: draft/polish/VI↔EN theo brief, giữ terminology và certainty.
criteria.negative: invent citation, đổi association thành causality, xóa limitation hoặc rewrite protected region phải fail/defer.
criteria.failure_or_output: Minimal diff/source-linked diff; numbers, units, negation, names, citations, modality và protected text unchanged; factual delta có evidence.
criteria.authority: AI disclosure/permission theo venue; không coi fluency là scientific validity.

criteria.positive: critique có vị trí, register, rhythm, vocabulary, audience/genre và owner preference.
criteria.negative: không AI detector, ban-word absolute, fake native gold hoặc scientific verdict.
criteria.failure_or_output: Suggestions cụ thể, tách defect khỏi subjective choice; full rewrite chỉ khi được phép; VI/EN profiles không trộn.
criteria.authority: Owner có thể tự review trong self-use; thiếu corpus/reader/domain thì verdict taste/domain `pending`.

criteria.positive: storyboard/chart/diagram/slide map source → mark/label/arrow và output medium.
criteria.negative: không tạo data/measurement, nhận raster là editable, hoặc gọi render/export pass khi chưa inspect.
criteria.failure_or_output: Axes/units/denominators/uncertainty/caption/alt/reading order đúng; source native mở được, objects editable, render gắn cùng hash và QA receipt.
criteria.authority: Asset/AI/venue rights và exact policy phải được clear; image processing giữ meaning.

criteria.positive: locate owner, symbol, dependency, caller và flow bằng path/line evidence.
criteria.negative: không thiết kế/sửa từ tên file đoán.
criteria.failure_or_output: Source map liệt kê verified path, caller và unknown; không claim runtime behavior khi chỉ đọc static.
criteria.authority: Read-only mặc định, không external write.

criteria.positive: symptom được reproduce, trace, counter-hypothesis và cause evidence.
criteria.negative: diagnose-only không patch; không đổi code chỉ vì stack trace đoán.
criteria.failure_or_output: Repro command/env/observed failure/limits; failed test giữ nguyên.
criteria.authority: Không production mutation, secrets hoặc paid provider; process trace phải thuộc scope.

criteria.positive: patch gắn cause đã chứng minh và có regression evidence.
criteria.negative: không refactor unrelated, disable failing test, hoặc che lỗi.
criteria.failure_or_output: Diff narrow, before/after test, failure/rollback, dirty-tree preservation.
criteria.authority: Backup/permission trước data change; không commit/push mặc định.

criteria.positive: test design/chạy theo touched contract, receipt có scope/env/result.
criteria.negative: không mock success, synthetic fixture thành live acceptance, unit pass thành integration/live proof.
criteria.failure_or_output: Test assertions observable; output/failure/timeout/unknown cleanup giữ đúng; broaden only when shared contract changes.
criteria.authority: Không gọi live/paid/external data nếu chưa grant.

criteria.positive: diff/public contract review tìm actionable issue theo severity/evidence.
criteria.negative: review-only không sửa code, không style churn/merge/publish.
criteria.failure_or_output: Finding có file/line, impact, repro/why, required edit; no finding cũng có inspected scope.
criteria.authority: Không biến scanner/LLM score thành security guarantee; code owner quyết định merge.

criteria.positive: asset/threat/trust boundary/repro/mitigation được lập.
criteria.negative: không pentest ngoài quyền, upload secret, hoặc claim secure vì scanner score.
criteria.failure_or_output: Threat model, evidence, residual risk, mitigation verification và fail-closed limits.
criteria.authority: Credentials/production/external target cần grant rõ; legal scope và privacy không đoán.

criteria.positive: minimum-sufficient packet, load/retire plan, measured/unknown context usage.
criteria.negative: không hard-code token window, leak secret, hoặc nhồi toàn repo.
criteria.failure_or_output: Packet giữ exact paths/versions/evidence/uncertainty; retire stale context; no secret in handoff.
criteria.authority: Access control/private store preserved; no provider/model assumption.

criteria.positive: user-visible behavior/setup/architecture/contract đổi thì sửa owning doc, source-checked links/examples.
criteria.negative: phase completion nội bộ không tự tạo docs churn; fetched docs không phải instruction authority.
criteria.failure_or_output: Link/source/version và example chạy được hoặc ghi limitation; docs diff khớp behavior/revision.
criteria.authority: Không publish mặc định, không copy policy/credential từ fetched page.

criteria.positive: UI contract gồm UX/a11y/components/state/performance và implementation/render checks theo quyền.
criteria.negative: không clone trademark/assets, ép framework, hoặc claim visual pass từ source text.
criteria.failure_or_output: WCAG/ARIA keyboard/name/contrast/alt/reading order; responsive/render evidence; Core Web Vitals nếu web.
criteria.authority: User data/privacy/asset rights; external deploy/publish cần grant.

criteria.positive: API/service/auth/data boundary có contract, validation, error/status và tests.
criteria.negative: không đổi DB/pricing/payment scope âm thầm, không expose secret.
criteria.failure_or_output: OpenAPI/RFC semantics, auth matrix, validation, error shape, integration receipt; no invented response schema.
criteria.authority: Production migration, payment, external API, credentials require explicit authority.

criteria.positive: schema/query/migration có data contract, backup, rollback, integrity checks.
criteria.negative: không drop/bulk-update/migrate chưa backup/quyền hoặc claim valid từ schema alone.
criteria.failure_or_output: Before/after row/schema/query evidence, backup/restore/rollback receipt, provenance/license/quality metadata.
criteria.authority: Privacy, retention, production DB và destructive action cần grant.

criteria.positive: reproducible build/env, rollout/health/rollback route được mô tả và kiểm.
criteria.negative: token có sẵn không đủ để deploy/cloud mutation.
criteria.failure_or_output: Build artifact/hash, inputs, builder/process, health/rollback/timeout/cleanup; failed deploy visible.
criteria.authority: External mutation, secrets, DNS/cloud resource require grant; no “production-ready” from local build.

criteria.positive: narrow diff/status/branch/commit/PR operation được user yêu cầu.
criteria.negative: không auto-commit/push/publish/reset/checkout over dirty edits.
criteria.failure_or_output: Exact diff, status, branch/ref, commit identity and preserved dirty tree; no invented clean state.
criteria.authority: User owns dirty tree; remote write and irreversible history action explicit.

criteria.positive: source repo được extract/compare/adapt theo manifest và decision matrix.
criteria.negative: compare-only không tự tạo plan/code; unknown license/dependency phải stop; không clone full repo/install mặc định.
criteria.failure_or_output: Source URL/revision/hash/license, anatomy, dependencies, disposition, local fit, rollback và report/plan; distinguish observed vs inferred.
criteria.authority: License, third-party assets, supply-chain provenance và package boundaries phải clear trước port.

criteria.positive: sourced market/customer/competitor map có sample/date/method.
criteria.negative: không bịa market size, quote, customer insight hoặc scrape private data.
criteria.failure_or_output: Source identity, geography/time, sample/unknowns, comparison axes và conflict ledger; fact vs inference tách.
criteria.authority: Privacy, consent, source terms; no direct marketing scope expansion.

criteria.positive: audience, positioning, message hierarchy, voice và design brief.
criteria.negative: không tự tạo final logo/asset, legal clearance hoặc trademark claim.
criteria.failure_or_output: Brief đủ audience/locale/voice/constraints; claims traceable; options có rationale, không giả human preference.
criteria.authority: Rights/trademark/legal owner; no publish/asset production without grant.

criteria.positive: strategy có goal/hypothesis/channel/KPI/budget decision/measurement constraints.
criteria.negative: không cấp spend, chạy campaign hoặc biến plan thành deploy.
criteria.failure_or_output: KPI definition/denominator, assumptions, dependencies, risk and rollback/comms; no invented forecast.
criteria.authority: Owner approves budget/audience/claims; external spend remains gate.

criteria.positive: brief đã có được chuyển thành channel/content schedule, task, asset acceptance và measurement.
criteria.negative: không run ads, tăng budget hoặc publish auto.
criteria.failure_or_output: Per-channel artifact, source/rights, dates/timezone, KPI/owner/status; no implied live execution.
criteria.authority: Consent, rights, ad policy and spend approval; vendor/platform mutation blocked.

criteria.positive: GTM sequence có readiness, audience, rollout/rollback/comms.
criteria.negative: không deploy product hoặc send notice mặc định.
criteria.failure_or_output: Launch checklist identifies product/release revision, dependencies, owners, rollback and unresolved gates.
criteria.authority: External publish/deploy/comms require approval; technical readiness does not equal market/legal readiness.

criteria.positive: content strategy/editorial pillars, intent, calendar, briefs, reuse/provenance.
criteria.negative: không rewrite/publish all copy from a strategy request.
criteria.failure_or_output: Audience/locale/channel/claims/rights and content lifecycle; source and refresh date; no copied corpus without rights.
criteria.authority: Privacy, license, publication route and owner approval.

criteria.positive: claim-grounded variants, CTA, tone and revisions theo brief.
criteria.negative: fake testimonial/scarcity/result, unsupported statistic, or fact drift must fail.
criteria.failure_or_output: Claim ledger maps each objective claim to source; distinguish subjective copy from factual support; variant diff preserved.
criteria.authority: FTC/CAP/jurisdiction, consent and legal review for regulated claims.

criteria.positive: search intent/crawl/index/on-page audit with prioritized fixes and observed URLs.
criteria.negative: no rank guarantee, keyword stuffing, cloaking or exploit.
criteria.failure_or_output: Evidence from crawl/Search Console/source; titles, links, text/alt/structured data and noindex/robots impact recorded.
criteria.authority: No DNS/robots/publish changes without grant; Google guidance is vendor-specific and ranking never guaranteed.

criteria.positive: lifecycle sequence/artifact with segments/assumptions/copy/suppression.
criteria.negative: no send or upload contacts from a draft request.
criteria.failure_or_output: Subject/header/body/CTA/opt-out/address, consent record and suppression path; no hidden transactional/commercial reclassification.
criteria.authority: CAN-SPAM/PECR/other jurisdiction and data controller approval; delivery adapter optional.

criteria.positive: platform-scoped drafts/calendar/moderation plan with source/rights.
criteria.negative: no post/follow/DM, fake organic evidence or engagement manipulation.
criteria.failure_or_output: Platform, locale, dates, hashtags/claims, disclosure, asset rights and moderation escalation are inspectable.
criteria.authority: Account access, consent, platform policy and external publication require grant.

criteria.positive: KPI/funnel/campaign readout with definitions and data-quality checks.
criteria.negative: no fabricated numbers, causal lift or attribution from correlation.
criteria.failure_or_output: Denominator, window, sampling/threshold/freshness, event validation and uncertainty retained; descriptive vs causal wording separated.
criteria.authority: Personal data access and causal/inferential signoff; GA4 definitions do not generalize to every platform.

criteria.positive: page/form/onboarding friction diagnosis with prioritized hypotheses and UX evidence.
criteria.negative: no uplift guarantee or live test launch.
criteria.failure_or_output: Funnel step, observed evidence, hypothesis, metric/guardrail and implementation owner; WCAG/accessibility issues separated from conversion claims.
criteria.authority: No traffic/budget/publish mutation; hypothesis passes to experiment owner.

criteria.positive: A/B design/readout with unit/randomization, success/guardrail/data-quality metrics, power/sample/stopping plan and uncertainty.
criteria.negative: no live traffic/budget change, peeking claim or causal language from observational data.
criteria.failure_or_output: Treatment/control, assignment, exposure, denominator, SRM/data-quality checks, effect/uncertainty, duration and limits; no invented results.
criteria.authority: Owner approval, privacy/ethics, telemetry and experiment platform; local design does not imply run.

acceptance_state_note: Owner verdict is local lane evidence; catalog status remains experimental and stable/scientific qualification is separate.
